summary: Private automation hub syncs collections from galaxy.ansible.com or console.redhat.com using Pulp content workers and the database; memory use scales with the number of collections and versions synced, so use a targeted requirements.yml with specific versions, and limit storage by setting the number of retained versions.
questions: Why does automation hub collection sync use so much memory?
How do I speed up collection sync in private automation hub?
How do I limit storage used by collections in automation hub?
